title: Taught an engineering community to use AI, rated 9.2 out of 10
summary: I surveyed the Innovation Engineering community before the session, then taught it 'Unlocking the future with AI'; the session was rated 9.2 out of 10.
what_would_have_happened: The content would rest on guesses about what engineers already knew about AI.
the_call: Ask the audience first, then build the session around their answers.
what_i_did: Ran a survey before the session, built the content from the answers and delivered it.
what_changed: Participants rated the session 9.2 out of 10.
